note: 24 Nov 2026 (the owner): Part 3 as young people talk. About 8 turns on 3-4 prompts, long and short turns alternating, at least one real disagreement. Tomás: React, Respond, Develop (a reason OR an example), Contrast or Ask. Beatriz: short, safe turns. Decision: about 4 turns; they agree, or agree to disagree.

stages.t: Let's start with learning online. I think it's really useful.
Mainly because you can watch a lesson again at home.
Really? I'm not so sure.
I see what you mean, but it's so easy to get distracted.
For example, last week I opened a maths video and ended up watching football clips for an hour!
What do you think about keeping in touch with friends?
Ha! Me too.
I think keeping in touch is very useful.
Mainly because some of my friends live in Lisbon.
Yeah, that's true.
I'd say it's the most useful thing technology does for us.
For example, my cousins live in London, and we video call every Sunday.
Although, to be honest, a call is never the same as being together.
Yes, I agree.
What about finding information? I use the internet for all my homework.
Me too, but we have to be careful.
Not everything online is true.
Mainly because anyone can write anything on the internet.
Do you always check what you read?
Not always, to be honest.
But I think being creative is useful too.
For example, I make short videos with my phone.
Oh, that's a great point!
Being creative is probably the most fun.
Mainly because you don't need expensive equipment any more.
However, I'm not sure it's as useful as the others.
So, which one shall we choose?
I think learning online, because it helps with school.
Hmm, I see what you mean, but I'd go for keeping in touch.
Mainly because feeling close to people really matters at our age.
Would you agree?
Yes, OK. Maybe you're right.
So, let's go for keeping in touch with friends, and learning online can be second.
Let's start with studying with friends. I think it's helpful.
Mainly because you can ask questions.
Yeah, I agree, up to a point.
It's great when everyone is serious.
For example, before our last history test, we tested each other in the library.
But sometimes we just end up chatting about football!
Ha! That's true.
What about getting a tutor? I think it's very helpful.
Really? I'm not so sure.
A tutor can be helpful, but it's very expensive.
Mainly because one lesson can cost twenty euros or more.
Do you think every family can pay for that?
No, you're right.
I think making a study timetable is better.
Mainly because it's free!
Exactly!
A timetable is probably the most practical idea.
For example, I stick my plan on the wall above my desk.
Although, to be honest, I don't always follow it!
What about getting enough sleep? I think it's very important.
Oh, definitely.
I think sleep is the one that people forget.
Mainly because we stay up late studying, and then we can't remember anything in the exam.
Do you sleep well before exams?
Not really. So, which one is the most helpful? I think getting enough sleep.
That's a good choice, but I'm not sure.
I'd say a study timetable is more helpful.
Mainly because if you plan well, you have time to sleep too!
What do you think?
Hmm, I still think sleep is more important.
OK, so we don't agree, and that's fine. You chose sleep, and I chose a study timetable.
Let's start with working in a café. I think it's a good idea.
Mainly because there are lots of tourists in summer.
Yeah, that's true, especially here in Funchal.
But I think it's quite hard work.
For example, my cousin worked in a café last summer, and she was on her feet for eight hours a day.
Would you like to do that?
Hmm, not really.
I prefer babysitting.
Mainly because I love children.
Really? Babysitting is not for me!
I think it's a big responsibility.
Mainly because you have to watch the children every second.
Although it's probably easier to find than a café job.
Yes, I agree.
What about selling things online?
Oh, that's a good one.
I think selling things online is really easy.
For example, last month I sold my old bike in two days.
The only problem is that you soon run out of things to sell!
Ha! That's true.
I think giving lessons to younger children is a good idea too.
Mainly because you can choose your hours.
Definitely.
It's also useful for you, not only for the money.
Mainly because explaining things helps you remember them.
However, younger children can be difficult to teach!
So, which one is the best? I think babysitting, because it pays well.
I see what you mean, but I'd choose giving lessons.
Mainly because you earn money and practise what you've learnt at the same time.
Does that make sense?
Yes, that's a good point. I agree.
Great, so we've decided: giving lessons to younger children.
Let's start with healthier school meals. I think it's a good idea.
Mainly because some meals at our school aren't very healthy.
Yeah, I agree.
Better meals would probably help more than anything else.
Mainly because we eat at school five days a week.
But do you think students would actually eat them?
Hmm, maybe not.
What about banning fizzy drinks? I think it's a good idea.
Really? I'm not so sure about that.
If you ban something, teenagers want it even more.
For example, when our school banned phones, everyone started hiding them in their bags.
Although it would probably help a little.
Ha! That's true.
I think more PE lessons are better.
Mainly because we sit down all day.
Exactly.
And an after-school sports club could be even better.
Mainly because students could choose a sport they really enjoy.
The only problem is that some people go home by bus straight after school.
What about lessons about mental health? I think they're important.
Especially before exams.
Oh, definitely.
I think people don't talk about mental health enough.
For example, lots of my friends feel stressed, but they never say anything.
Do you think a lesson would help?
Yes, I think so. So, which one should the school do first? I think more PE lessons.
That's a good idea, but I'd start with lessons about mental health.
Mainly because being healthy isn't only about your body.
What do you think?
Yes, you're right. Let's choose that one.
OK, so the school should start with lessons about mental health.
Let's start with recycling at home. I think it's easy, and everyone can do it.
Yeah, that's true.
But it's only a small step.
For example, my family recycles everything, but we still use the car every day.
What about using public transport?
I think it's a good idea, but the buses here are often late.
Exactly, that's the problem.
Public transport would make a huge difference.
Mainly because there are so many cars in Funchal.
However, it won't happen until the buses get better.
Yes, I agree.
What about joining a beach clean-up? I did one last year, and I really enjoyed it.
Really? That's great!
Beach clean-ups are good, especially on an island.
For example, my class collected three bags of plastic at Praia Formosa.
Although the next day there was more rubbish!
I think buying fewer clothes is important too.
Mainly because fast fashion is bad for the planet.
Hmm, maybe.
That's true, but it's really hard for teenagers.
Mainly because everyone wants to look good on social media.
Do you buy a lot of clothes?
Not really. So, which one would make the biggest difference? I think the beach clean-up.
I see what you mean, but I'd say public transport.
Mainly because it would mean fewer cars every single day.
Would you agree?
Hmm, I'm not sure. I still prefer the beach clean-up.
OK, so we don't agree, and that's fine. You chose the beach clean-up, and I chose public transport.
Let's start with eating meals together. I think it's nice.
Mainly because you can talk about your day.
Yeah, I agree.
Dinner is the only time my whole family is together.
Mainly because my parents work late every day.
The only problem is that my little brother always watches videos at the table!
Ha! Mine too.
What about going on holiday? I think it's very enjoyable.
Hmm, I'm not so sure.
Holidays can be fun, but they can also be stressful.
For example, last summer we spent six hours at the airport, and everybody was angry.
Do you enjoy family holidays?
Yes, I do.
We go to Porto Santo every summer, and it's always fun.
That sounds great.
I think visiting grandparents is really important.
Mainly because they have amazing stories about Madeira in the past.
Although some teenagers find it a bit boring.
I think playing games at home is fun too.
Especially on rainy days.
Definitely.
Games are great for the whole family.
For example, at Christmas we play cards with my grandmother until midnight.
However, we always argue about who's winning!
So, which one would bring a family closer? I think going on holiday.
I see what you mean, but I'd say eating meals together.
Mainly because you do it every day, not only once a year.
What do you think?
That's true. OK, let's choose eating meals together.
Great, so we agree: eating meals together.
